facts.fact: The advocacy author (DRAA) states about 18 million people, about 40 percent of the population, lack a National ID, implying roughly 60 percent hold one; the estimate carries no cited source.

facts.fact: The author says the SAGE social grant only benefits people on the National Identification Register with a national ID, and the education portal EMIS requires a NIN of learners and staff.

The author describes the National ID (Ndaga Muntu, issued by NIRA under the Registration of Persons Act) as a system with a biometric backbone and centralised database, which the High Court held on 2025-06-10 operates primarily offline.
